name: cookoffchamps
description: Family cookoff voting: organizers set up an event, guests scan a QR code and vote blind, winners are revealed 3rd to 1st.

scripts.build: esbuild src/client/main.ts --bundle --minify --sourcemap --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=public/app.js && node scripts/build-help.mjs && node scripts/build-printables.mjs && node scripts/build-notices.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run check-publish && wrangler deploy
